description: Duivelseiland 1899-1900 speculative rows (Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 50-72, Balthasar Floriszstraat 4-10 and 18-26): 5.2-5.7 m orange-red brick fronts of four storeys under a white timber cornice at 13.4 m over a 0.75 m brick corbel-table frieze; three equal axes of white T-windows (a top light over two casements) with white sills; flat heads on every storey (the twin of museum-de-1899-corbel-cornice: same row, same builder, no arch rings); an iron balconette on a slab on the centre axis of storeys 1 and 2; one white pediment dormer with a carved crest over the centre; the house door with its transom on an end axis

match.note: Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 62-68 and Balthasar Floriszstraat 18-24 on the 2024-12-11 strips (40 px/m, 1 m grid): white cornice top 13.35-13.5 m; 3DBAG eaves 15.2-15.8 m read the roof behind it (the dark roof face shows 13.5-14.2 m between the dormers), so the cornice is the type's front line (frontEavesM). BAG 1899-1900 on the exemplars; widths 5.2-5.7 m. The strip skyline reads 14.5-14.9 m on the clean-sky pands (Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 50-70, Balthasar Floriszstraat 2A-8, 18, 32-34): the top of the dark roof face behind the cornice, between the dormers (frontSkylineM). Twin of museum-de-1899-corbel-cornice: the arch rings over storeys 1-2 are the only difference (Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 62, 68-70, Balthasar Floriszstraat 22 against their arched neighbours); the edges cannot tell them apart reliably, so reviewed pands are pinned (duivelseiland-review-types.json)

pediment-dormer.note: Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 62-68: one white dormer 1.2-1.3 m wide over the centre axis, its body 13.5-14.6 m to a pediment with a carved crest to about 15.2 m (the crest is not drawn)

door-left.note: Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 66, Balthasar Floriszstraat 24: the house door with a transom on the left axis, two windows. Door reveal: Frans van Mierisstraat side of Anthonisz (160204) at -37/+43 deg: the door stands at the back of a plastered (cream-painted) vestibule, side wall 60 of 190 px at 37 deg and 85 of 205 px at 43 deg -> 0.5 m to the leaf on a 1.2 m opening; 158092 the same with a lit vestibule ceiling; no step.

door-right.note: Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 64 and 68, Balthasar Floriszstraat 18: mirrored, the door on the right axis. Door reveal: Frans van Mierisstraat side of Anthonisz (160204) at -37/+43 deg: the door stands at the back of a plastered (cream-painted) vestibule, side wall 60 of 190 px at 37 deg and 85 of 205 px at 43 deg -> 0.5 m to the leaf on a 1.2 m opening; 158092 the same with a lit vestibule ceiling; no step.

rhythm.identicalBays: every upper storey: three T-windows of one width (1.1-1.15 m)
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; the door on the left or right axis
rhythm.groundFloor: residential: house door with a transom and two windows
rhythm.roofline: white timber cornice at 13.4 m over a brick corbel-table frieze; one white pediment dormer

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-12-11 at 40 px/m (Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 70, 68, 62): storey lines, cornice, corbel table and dormers as on 66-62 within 0.1 m; storey 1-2 windows 3.6-5.9 m and 6.5-8.85 m square-headed under a flat brick lintel, no arch ring
strip.jpg 2024-12-11 (Balthasar Floriszstraat 22): flat-headed between the arched 24 and 20
